in_hebrew.name: Meyer
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Meyer הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the old German name 'Meizari', meaning 'little Mercury'. This name is of German origin and is commonly used among Jews of Ashkenazi descent. The name Meyer is associated with strength, courage, and wisdom.
